name: knot-topology-stopword
description: Adversarial: stop-word leak. Queries carry four genuine knot-topology anchors PLUS three low-information filler tags. The four real anchors alone would score 4/8 = 0.5 and fire; the filler inflates the query union to 11, dropping the score to 4/11 ~= 0.36 below the 0.4 threshold. Demonstrates symbol-extraction noise diluting recall.
sentence_templates: how do {0} and {1} relate to {2} and {3}, considering {4}, {5}, and {6}?
as {4} with {5}, what links {0}, {1}, {2}, and {3} under {6}?
